descriptions.description:
• License number: 10006726
  • Commercial Registration No: 7014411487

Embrace the beauty and holiness of Mecca, during your stay at Manazel Ajyad Hotel By Elaf where you will enjoy your unforgettable experience for visiting Tower Monument Landmark, Kabutor Chowk ( Pigeon Square ) and The Clock Towers.

Manazel Ajyad Hotel By Elaf accommodations are havens of tranquillity with the facilities provided in most of them such as air conditioning, refrigerator, coffee/tea maker, TV, safe and cribs.

Explore your once-in-a-lifetime taste at Manazel Ajyad Hotel By Elaf eateries serving a variety of cuisines.

A stay at Manazel Ajyad Hotel By Elaf places you in the heart of Makkah, within a 10-minute walk of Great Mosque of Makkah and Abraj Al-Bait Towers. This hotel is 0.5 mi (0.8 km) from Kaaba and 0.4 mi (0.6 km) from Abraj Al Bait Hajar Tower.

Distances are displayed to the nearest 0.1 mile and kilometer.

The preferred airport for Manazel Ajyad Hotel By Elaf is King Abdulaziz Intl. Airport (JED) - 95.2 km / 59.2 mi
Grab a bite at one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee.

Make yourself at home in one of the 355 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and coffee/tea makers, and housekeeping is provided on request.
Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Guests can get around on the complimentary shuttle, which operates within 1 km.
Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk.

policies.policyDetails:
• Only Muslims are allowed to enter the holy cities of Mecca and Medina.
  • The property has connecting/adjoining rooms, which are subject to availability and can be requested by contacting the property using the number on the booking confirmation.
  • Alcohol is not served or permitted at this property.
  • This property advises that enhanced cleaning and guest safety measures are currently in place.
  • Disinfectant is used to clean the property.
  • Personal protective equipment, including masks and gloves, will be available to guests.
  • Social distancing measures are in place; staff at the property wear personal protective equipment; periodic temperature checks are conducted on staff; guests are provided with hand sanitizer.
  • Contactless check-in is available.
  • Individually-wrapped food options are available through room service.
  • Each guestroom is kept vacant for a minimum of 72 hours between bookings.

The following fees and deposits are charged by the property at time of service, check-in, or check-out.

  • Fee for buffet breakfast: SAR 35 per person (approximately)

The above list may not be comprehensive. Fees and deposits may not include tax and are subject to change.

• Extra-person charges may apply and vary depending on property policy
  • Government-issued photo identification and a credit card, debit card, or cash deposit may be required at check-in for incidental charges
  • Special requests are subject to availability upon check-in and may incur additional charges; special requests cannot be guaranteed
  • No onsite parking is available
  • This property accepts credit cards, debit cards, and cash
  • Safety features at this property include a carbon monoxide detector, a fire extinguisher, a smoke detector, a security system, a first aid kit, and window guards
  • Please note that cultural norms and guest policies may differ by country and by property; the policies listed are provided by the property

Front desk staff will greet guests on arrival.

Room occupancy is determined by the property and accommodates the number of guests selected in your search. Bedding arrangements may vary and may not always include a separate bed for each guest. Please ensure the room you book meets your bedding requirements.

Please note that if the bed type (e.g., double bed or twin beds) is not explicitly specified in the room name, bed configuration is subject to hotel availability upon check-in.

descriptions.description:
• License number: 10006726
  • Commercial Registration No: 7014411487

Embrace the beauty and holiness of Mecca, during your stay at Manazel Ajyad Hotel By Elaf where you will enjoy your unforgettable experience for visiting Tower Monument Landmark, Kabutor Chowk ( Pigeon Square ) and The Clock Towers.

Manazel Ajyad Hotel By Elaf accommodations are havens of tranquillity with the facilities provided in most of them such as air conditioning, refrigerator, coffee/tea maker, TV, safe and cribs.

Explore your once-in-a-lifetime taste at Manazel Ajyad Hotel By Elaf eateries serving a variety of cuisines.

A stay at Manazel Ajyad Hotel By Elaf places you in the heart of Makkah, within a 10-minute walk of Great Mosque of Makkah and Abraj Al-Bait Towers. This hotel is 0.5 mi (0.8 km) from Kaaba and 0.4 mi (0.6 km) from Abraj Al Bait Hajar Tower.

Distances are displayed to the nearest 0.1 mile and kilometer.

Abraj Al Bait Hajar Tower - 0.6 km / 0.4 mi
Great Mosque of Makkah - 0.6 km / 0.4 mi
Abraj Al-Bait Towers - 0.7 km / 0.4 mi
Well of Zamzam - 0.8 km / 0.5 mi
Maqam Ibrahim - 0.8 km / 0.5 mi
Kaaba - 0.8 km / 0.5 mi
Black Stone - 0.8 km / 0.5 mi
King Fahad Gate - 0.8 km / 0.5 mi
Al-Salam Gate - 0.8 km / 0.5 mi
Alkhalil Courtyard - 1 km / 0.6 mi
Souk Al-Khalil - 1.1 km / 0.7 mi
Safa and Marwah - 1.3 km / 0.8 mi
60th Street - 1.7 km / 1 mi
As-Haabee Exhibition - 2 km / 1.2 mi
Masjid Al-Jinn - 2.1 km / 1.3 mi

The preferred airport for Manazel Ajyad Hotel By Elaf is King Abdulaziz Intl. Airport (JED) - 95.2 km / 59.2 mi
Grab a bite at one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee.

Make yourself at home in one of the 355 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and coffee/tea makers, and housekeeping is provided on request.
Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Guests can get around on the complimentary shuttle, which operates within 1 km.
Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk.

policies.policyDetails:
• Only Muslims are allowed to enter the holy cities of Mecca and Medina.
  • The property has connecting/adjoining rooms, which are subject to availability and can be requested by contacting the property using the number on the booking confirmation.
  • Alcohol is not served or permitted at this property.
  • This property advises that enhanced cleaning and guest safety measures are currently in place.
  • Disinfectant is used to clean the property.
  • Personal protective equipment, including masks and gloves, will be available to guests.
  • Social distancing measures are in place; staff at the property wear personal protective equipment; periodic temperature checks are conducted on staff; guests are provided with hand sanitizer.
  • Contactless check-in is available.
  • Individually-wrapped food options are available through room service.
  • Each guestroom is kept vacant for a minimum of 72 hours between bookings.

The following fees and deposits are charged by the property at time of service, check-in, or check-out.

  • Fee for buffet breakfast: SAR 35 per person (approximately)

The above list may not be comprehensive. Fees and deposits may not include tax and are subject to change.

• Extra-person charges may apply and vary depending on property policy
  • Government-issued photo identification and a credit card, debit card, or cash deposit may be required at check-in for incidental charges
  • Special requests are subject to availability upon check-in and may incur additional charges; special requests cannot be guaranteed
  • No onsite parking is available
  • This property accepts credit cards, debit cards, and cash
  • Safety features at this property include a carbon monoxide detector, a fire extinguisher, a smoke detector, a security system, a first aid kit, and window guards
  • Please note that cultural norms and guest policies may differ by country and by property; the policies listed are provided by the property

Front desk staff will greet guests on arrival.

Room occupancy is determined by the property and accommodates the number of guests selected in your search. Bedding arrangements may vary and may not always include a separate bed for each guest. Please ensure the room you book meets your bedding requirements.

Please note that if the bed type (e.g., double bed or twin beds) is not explicitly specified in the room name, bed configuration is subject to hotel availability upon check-in.

descriptions.description:

Kingsgate Hotel Durrat, like no other, is perfectly situated in Al Madinah, as it is surrounded by many enjoyable landmarks such as Al Baqia Cemetry. It also has a vital location because of being near to Mazaya Mall.

Kingsgate Hotel Durrat ensures guests’ recreational moments with Kingsgate Hotel Durrat comfy and elegant accommodations offering air conditioning, telephones and sofas.

A stay at Kingsgate Hotel Durrat places you in the heart of Madinah, within a 5-minute drive of Prophet's Mosque and Al-Baqi Cemetery. This hotel is 2.1 mi (3.4 km) from Al Noor Mall and 3 mi (4.8 km) from Qiblatain Mosque.

Distances are displayed to the nearest 0.1 mile and kilometer.

Masjid Abu Dharr al Ghifari - 0.9 km / 0.6 mi
Masjid Al Ghamamah - 1 km / 0.6 mi
Prophet's Mosque - 1.1 km / 0.7 mi
The Green Dome - 1.1 km / 0.7 mi
Al-Baqi Cemetery - 1.3 km / 0.8 mi
Al-Safiya Museum and Garden - 1.5 km / 0.9 mi
New Bilal Market - 1.8 km / 1.1 mi
Al Hijaz Railway Museum - 1.8 km / 1.1 mi
Bilal Ibn Rabah Mosque - 1.8 km / 1.1 mi
The Seven Mosques - 2.1 km / 1.3 mi
Ali Ibn Abi Talib Mosque - 2.4 km / 1.5 mi
Historical Quba Castle - 3.2 km / 2 mi
Masjid Al-Jummah - 3.6 km / 2.2 mi
Uhud Martyrs Square - 3.9 km / 2.4 mi
Uhud Battle Field - 4 km / 2.5 mi

The nearest airports are:
Madinah (MED-Prince Mohammad Bin Abdulaziz) - 15.6 km / 9.7 mi
King Abdulaziz Intl. Airport (JED) - 395.3 km / 245.6 mi
Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service.

Make yourself at home in one of the 420 air-conditioned rooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature hair dryers and bathrobes. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily.
Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and laundry facilities.

The host will greet guests on arrival.

Room occupancy is determined by the property and accommodates the number of guests selected in your search. Bedding arrangements may vary and may not always include a separate bed for each guest. Please ensure the room you book meets your bedding requirements.

Please note that if the bed type (e.g., double bed or twin beds) is not explicitly specified in the room name, bed configuration is subject to hotel availability upon check-in.

• Rollaway bed fee: AED 100.0 per night

The above list may not be comprehensive. Fees and deposits may not include tax and are subject to change.

descriptions.description:
• License number: 10008838
  • Commercial Registration No: 4650225421

Kingsgate Hotel Durrat, like no other, is perfectly situated in Al Madinah, as it is surrounded by many enjoyable landmarks such as Al Baqia Cemetry. It also has a vital location because of being near to Mazaya Mall.

Kingsgate Hotel Durrat ensures guests’ recreational moments with Kingsgate Hotel Durrat comfy and elegant accommodations offering air conditioning, telephones and sofas.

A stay at Kingsgate Hotel Durrat places you in the heart of Madinah, within a 5-minute drive of Prophet's Mosque and Al-Baqi Cemetery. This hotel is 2.1 mi (3.4 km) from Al Noor Mall and 3 mi (4.8 km) from Qiblatain Mosque.

Distances are displayed to the nearest 0.1 mile and kilometer.

Masjid Al Ghamamah - 1 km / 0.6 mi

Al-Baqi Cemetery - 1.3 km / 0.8 mi
Al-Safiya Museum and Garden - 1.5 km / 0.9 mi
New Bilal Market - 1.8 km / 1.1 mi
Al Hijaz Railway Museum - 1.8 km / 1.1 mi

The Seven Mosques - 2.1 km / 1.3 mi
Ali Ibn Abi Talib Mosque - 2.4 km / 1.5 mi
Historical Quba Castle - 3.2 km / 2 mi
Masjid Al-Jummah - 3.6 km / 2.2 mi
Uhud Martyrs Square - 3.9 km / 2.4 mi
Uhud Battle Field - 4 km / 2.5 mi

The nearest airports are:
Madinah (MED-Prince Mohammad Bin Abdulaziz) - 15.6 km / 9.7 mi
King Abdulaziz Intl. Airport (JED) - 395.3 km / 245.6 mi
Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service.

Make yourself at home in one of the 420 air-conditioned rooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature hair dryers and bathrobes. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily.
Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and laundry facilities.

policies.policyDetails:
• Only Muslims are allowed to enter the holy cities of Mecca and Medina.
  • Couples wishing to share a room must provide proof of marriage.
  • Contactless check-in and contactless check-out are available.

• Extra-person charges may apply and vary depending on property policy

descriptions.description:
• License number: 10008380


    Embrace the beauty and holiness of Medina, during your stay at Al Manakha Rotana Madinah where you will enjoy your unforgettable experience for visiting Jabal Ahad Garden Park, King Fahad Garden and Knowledge Economic City.

    Al Manakha Rotana Madinah accommodations are havens of tranquillity with the breathtaking views of City and the facilities provided in most of them such as Wi-Fi, seating area, desk, minibar, iron and clothes rack.

    Explore your once-in-a-lifetime taste at Al Manakha Rotana Madinah eateries serving a variety of cuisines.

Situated in front of the Prophet's Mosque (PBUH) of Al Masjid Al Nabawi, Al Manakha Rotana Madinah is a 2-tower haven of comfort and convenience, offering pilgrims an ideal base for their spiritual journey to Saudi Arabia. Stepping outside the hotel, guests can explore the vibrant surroundings, from shops to cafes and iconic historical mosques like Omar bin Khattab Mosque and Al Ghamamah. The four-star hotel seamlessly blends modern comfort with spiritual significance, creating a truly enriching stay for those embarking on a pilgrimage or seeking a unique cultural experience.

With a stay at Rotana Al Manakha Madinah, you'll be centrally located in Madinah, a 3-minute drive from Prophet's Mosque and 6 minutes from Quba Mosque.  This hotel is 0.7 mi (1.1 km) from Masjid Al Ghamamah and 1.2 mi (2 km) from Ali Ibn Abi Talib Mosque.

Make yourself at home in one of the 512 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and Smart televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers, hair dryers, and bathrobes. Conveniences include phones, as well as desks and complimentary bottled water.

Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional features at this hotel include shopping on site, a reception hall, and a vending machine.

descriptions.description:
• License number: 10008380


    Embrace the beauty and holiness of Medina, during your stay at Al Manakha Rotana Madinah where you will enjoy your unforgettable experience for visiting Jabal Ahad Garden Park, King Fahad Garden and Knowledge Economic City.

    Al Manakha Rotana Madinah accommodations are havens of tranquillity with the breathtaking views of City and the facilities provided in most of them such as Wi-Fi, seating area, desk, minibar, iron and clothes rack.

    Explore your once-in-a-lifetime taste at Al Manakha Rotana Madinah eateries serving a variety of cuisines.

Situated in front of the Prophet's Mosque (PBUH) of Al Masjid Al Nabawi, Al Manakha Rotana Madinah is a 2-tower haven of comfort and convenience, offering pilgrims an ideal base for their spiritual journey to Saudi Arabia. Stepping outside the hotel, guests can explore the vibrant surroundings, from shops to cafes and iconic historical mosques like Omar bin Khattab Mosque and Al Ghamamah. The four-star hotel seamlessly blends modern comfort with spiritual significance, creating a truly enriching stay for those embarking on a pilgrimage or seeking a unique cultural experience.

With a stay at Rotana Al Manakha Madinah, you'll be centrally located in Madinah, a 3-minute drive from Prophet's Mosque and 6 minutes from Quba Mosque.  This hotel is 0.7 mi (1.1 km) from Masjid Al Ghamamah and 1.2 mi (2 km) from Ali Ibn Abi Talib Mosque.

Distances are displayed to the nearest 0.1 mile and kilometer.

Masjid Al Ghamamah - 0.3 km / 0.2 mi

The nearest airports are:
Madinah (MED-Prince Mohammad Bin Abdulaziz) - 16.5 km / 10.2 mi
King Abdulaziz Intl. Airport (JED) - 395 km / 245.4 mi

Enjoy international cuisine at Al Noor Restaurant, one of the hotel's many dining establishments, which include 2 restaurants and 2 coffee shops/cafes. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Children aged 6 and younger eat free breakfast.

Make yourself at home in one of the 512 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and Smart televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers, hair dryers, and bathrobes. Conveniences include phones, as well as desks and complimentary bottled water.

Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional features at this hotel include shopping on site, a reception hall, and a vending machine.
Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Free self parking is available onsite.

policies.policyDetails:
• Extra-person charges may apply and vary depending on property policy
  • Government-issued photo identification and a credit card, debit card, or cash deposit may be required at check-in for incidental charges
  • Special requests are subject to availability upon check-in and may incur additional charges; special requests cannot be guaranteed
  • The name on the credit card used at check-in to pay for incidentals must be the primary name on the guestroom reservation
  • This property accepts credit cards, debit cards, mobile payments, and cash
  • This property reserves the right to pre-authorize the guest's credit card prior to arrival.
  • Cashless transactions are available
  • Onsite parties or group events are strictly prohibited
  • Safety features at this property include a fire extinguisher and a smoke detector

Front desk staff will greet guests on arrival at the property. Information provided by the property may be translated using automated translation tools.

Room occupancy is determined by the property and accommodates the number of guests selected in your search. Bedding arrangements may vary and may not always include a separate bed for each guest. Please ensure the room you book meets your bedding requirements.

Please note that if the bed type (e.g., double bed or twin beds) is not explicitly specified in the room name, bed configuration is subject to hotel availability upon check-in.

• Fee for buffet breakfast: approximately SAR 100 per person
  • Early check-in is available for a fee (subject to availability)

The above list may not be comprehensive. Fees and deposits may not include tax and are subject to change.

• Local laws may restrict unmarried guests from sharing rooms. Guests are responsible for providing proof of marriage, if requested by the property.
  • Couples wishing to share a room must provide proof of marriage.
  • One child 12 years old or younger stays free when occupying the parent or guardian's room, using existing bedding.
  • The property has connecting/adjoining rooms, which are subject to availability and can be requested by contacting the property using the number on the booking confirmation.
  • No pets and no service animals are allowed at this property.
  • Alcohol is not served or permitted at this property.
  • A car is not required for transportation to and from this property.
  • Parking height restrictions apply.
  • Cashless payment methods are available for all transactions.

descriptions.description:
• License number: 10008380


    Embrace the beauty and holiness of Medina, during your stay at Al Manakha Rotana Madinah where you will enjoy your unforgettable experience for visiting Jabal Ahad Garden Park, King Fahad Garden and Knowledge Economic City.

    Al Manakha Rotana Madinah accommodations are havens of tranquillity with the breathtaking views of City and the facilities provided in most of them such as Wi-Fi, seating area, desk, minibar, iron and clothes rack.

    Explore your once-in-a-lifetime taste at Al Manakha Rotana Madinah eateries serving a variety of cuisines.

Situated in front of the Prophet's Mosque (PBUH) of Al Masjid Al Nabawi, Al Manakha Rotana Madinah is a 2-tower haven of comfort and convenience, offering pilgrims an ideal base for their spiritual journey to Saudi Arabia. Stepping outside the hotel, guests can explore the vibrant surroundings, from shops to cafes and iconic historical mosques like Omar bin Khattab Mosque and Al Ghamamah. The four-star hotel seamlessly blends modern comfort with spiritual significance, creating a truly enriching stay for those embarking on a pilgrimage or seeking a unique cultural experience.

With a stay at Rotana Al Manakha Madinah, you'll be centrally located in Madinah, a 3-minute drive from Prophet's Mosque and 6 minutes from Quba Mosque.  This hotel is 0.7 mi (1.1 km) from Masjid Al Ghamamah and 1.2 mi (2 km) from Ali Ibn Abi Talib Mosque.

Distances are displayed to the nearest 0.1 mile and kilometer.

Masjid Al Ghamamah - 0.3 km / 0.2 mi
Al Hijaz Railway Museum - 0.7 km / 0.4 mi
Al-Safiya Museum and Garden - 0.8 km / 0.5 mi
Prophet's Mosque - 0.8 km / 0.5 mi
The Green Dome - 0.9 km / 0.5 mi
New Bilal Market - 0.9 km / 0.6 mi
Bilal Ibn Rabah Mosque - 1 km / 0.6 mi
Al-Baqi Cemetery - 1 km / 0.6 mi
Masjid Abu Dharr al Ghifari - 1.8 km / 1.1 mi
Ali Ibn Abi Talib Mosque - 2.1 km / 1.3 mi
Historical Quba Castle - 2.2 km / 1.3 mi
The Seven Mosques - 2.3 km / 1.4 mi
Masjid Al-Jummah - 2.5 km / 1.6 mi
Madina Mall - 3.2 km / 2 mi
Quba Mosque - 3.2 km / 2 mi

The nearest airports are:
Madinah (MED-Prince Mohammad Bin Abdulaziz) - 16.5 km / 10.2 mi
King Abdulaziz Intl. Airport (JED) - 395 km / 245.4 mi

Enjoy international cuisine at Al Noor Restaurant, one of the hotel's many dining establishments, which include 2 restaurants and 2 coffee shops/cafes. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Children aged 6 and younger eat free breakfast.

Make yourself at home in one of the 512 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and Smart televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers, hair dryers, and bathrobes. Conveniences include phones, as well as desks and complimentary bottled water.

Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional features at this hotel include shopping on site, a reception hall, and a vending machine.
Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Free self parking is available onsite.

• Extra-person charges may apply and vary depending on property policy
  • Government-issued photo identification and a credit card, debit card, or cash deposit may be required at check-in for incidental charges
  • Special requests are subject to availability upon check-in and may incur additional charges; special requests cannot be guaranteed
  • The name on the credit card used at check-in to pay for incidentals must be the primary name on the guestroom reservation
  • This property accepts credit cards, debit cards, mobile payments, and cash
  • This property reserves the right to pre-authorize the guest's credit card prior to arrival.
  • Cashless transactions are available
  • Onsite parties or group events are strictly prohibited
  • Safety features at this property include a fire extinguisher and a smoke detector

Front desk staff will greet guests on arrival at the property. Information provided by the property may be translated using automated translation tools.

Room occupancy is determined by the property and accommodates the number of guests selected in your search. Bedding arrangements may vary and may not always include a separate bed for each guest. Please ensure the room you book meets your bedding requirements.

Please note that if the bed type (e.g., double bed or twin beds) is not explicitly specified in the room name, bed configuration is subject to hotel availability upon check-in.

• Fee for buffet breakfast: approximately SAR 100 per person
  • Early check-in is available for a fee (subject to availability)

The above list may not be comprehensive. Fees and deposits may not include tax and are subject to change.

• Local laws may restrict unmarried guests from sharing rooms. Guests are responsible for providing proof of marriage, if requested by the property.
  • Couples wishing to share a room must provide proof of marriage.
  • One child 12 years old or younger stays free when occupying the parent or guardian's room, using existing bedding.
  • The property has connecting/adjoining rooms, which are subject to availability and can be requested by contacting the property using the number on the booking confirmation.
  • No pets and no service animals are allowed at this property.
  • Alcohol is not served or permitted at this property.
  • A car is not required for transportation to and from this property.
  • Parking height restrictions apply.
  • Cashless payment methods are available for all transactions.

descriptions.description:
• License number: 10006741
  • Commercial Registration No: 4031302414

Embrace the beauty and holiness of mecca, during your stay at Elaf Qinwan Hotel where you will enjoy your unforgettable experience for visiting Clock Tower Museum, Baghdadi Mosque and Mount Ismail.

Elaf Qinwan Hotel accommodations are havens of tranquillity with the breathtaking views of City and Mountain and the facilities provided in most of them such as balcony, Wi-Fi, seating area, air conditioning, electric kettle and TV.

Explore your once-in-a-lifetime taste at Elaf Qinwan Hotel eateries serving a variety of cuisines.

With a stay at Elaf Qinwan Hotel  in Makkah (Al Hindawiyah), you'll be within a 5-minute drive of Great Mosque of Makkah and King Fahad Gate.  This hotel is 5 mi (8.1 km) from Kaaba and 1.9 mi (3.1 km) from The Clock Towers.

Distances are displayed to the nearest 0.1 mile and kilometer.

Continental breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee.

Make yourself at home in one of the 474 air-conditioned guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and irons/ironing boards.
Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services.
Featured amenities include a business center, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Free self parking is available onsite.

descriptions.description:
• License number: 10006741
  • Commercial Registration No: 4031302414

Embrace the beauty and holiness of mecca, during your stay at Elaf Qinwan Hotel where you will enjoy your unforgettable experience for visiting Clock Tower Museum, Baghdadi Mosque and Mount Ismail.

Elaf Qinwan Hotel accommodations are havens of tranquillity with the breathtaking views of City and Mountain and the facilities provided in most of them such as balcony, Wi-Fi, seating area, air conditioning, electric kettle and TV.

Explore your once-in-a-lifetime taste at Elaf Qinwan Hotel eateries serving a variety of cuisines.

With a stay at Elaf Qinwan Hotel  in Makkah (Al Hindawiyah), you'll be within a 5-minute drive of Great Mosque of Makkah and King Fahad Gate.  This hotel is 5 mi (8.1 km) from Kaaba and 1.9 mi (3.1 km) from The Clock Towers.

Distances are displayed to the nearest 0.1 mile and kilometer.

60th Street - 1 km / 0.6 mi
As-Haabee Exhibition - 2.5 km / 1.5 mi
Great Mosque of Makkah - 2.8 km / 1.7 mi
Alkhalil Courtyard - 3 km / 1.9 mi
Souk Al-Khalil - 3.1 km / 1.9 mi
King Fahad Gate - 3.1 km / 2 mi
Well of Zamzam - 3.2 km / 2 mi
Maqam Ibrahim - 3.3 km / 2 mi
Kaaba - 3.3 km / 2 mi
Black Stone - 3.3 km / 2 mi
Al Diyafa Mall - 3.3 km / 2.1 mi
The Clock Towers - 3.4 km / 2.1 mi
Al-Salam Gate - 3.4 km / 2.1 mi
Safa and Marwah - 3.5 km / 2.2 mi
Abdul-Qadir Ahmed Nassier Mosque - 3.7 km / 2.3 mi

The nearest major airport is King Abdulaziz Intl. Airport (JED) - 92.2 km / 57.3 mi
Continental breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee.

Make yourself at home in one of the 474 air-conditioned guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and irons/ironing boards.
Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services.
Featured amenities include a business center, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Free self parking is available onsite.
Arabic,English

policies.policyDetails:
Fee for continental breakfast: approximately SAR 35 to 75 per person

The above list may not be comprehensive. Fees and deposits may not include tax and are subject to change.

Front desk staff will greet guests on arrival at the property. Information provided by the property may be translated using automated translation tools.

Room occupancy is determined by the property and accommodates the number of guests selected in your search. Bedding arrangements may vary and may not always include a separate bed for each guest. Please ensure the room you book meets your bedding requirements.

Please note that if the bed type (e.g., double bed or twin beds) is not explicitly specified in the room name, bed configuration is subject to hotel availability upon check-in.
Couples wishing to share a room must provide proof of marriage.

Extra-person charges may apply and vary depending on property policy

  • Government-issued photo identification and a credit card, debit card, or cash deposit may be required at check-in for incidental charges
  • Special requests are subject to availability upon check-in and may incur additional charges; special requests cannot be guaranteed
  • This property accepts credit cards and debit cards; cash is not accepted

descriptions.description:
• License number: 10006741
  • Commercial Registration No: 4031302414

Embrace the beauty and holiness of mecca, during your stay at Elaf Qinwan Hotel where you will enjoy your unforgettable experience for visiting Clock Tower Museum, Baghdadi Mosque and Mount Ismail.

Elaf Qinwan Hotel accommodations are havens of tranquillity with the breathtaking views of City and Mountain and the facilities provided in most of them such as balcony, Wi-Fi, seating area, air conditioning, electric kettle and TV.

Explore your once-in-a-lifetime taste at Elaf Qinwan Hotel eateries serving a variety of cuisines.

With a stay at Elaf Qinwan Hotel  in Makkah (Al Hindawiyah), you'll be within a 5-minute drive of Great Mosque of Makkah and King Fahad Gate.  This hotel is 5 mi (8.1 km) from Kaaba and 1.9 mi (3.1 km) from The Clock Towers.

Distances are displayed to the nearest 0.1 mile and kilometer.

60th Street - 1 km / 0.6 mi
As-Haabee Exhibition - 2.5 km / 1.5 mi
Great Mosque of Makkah - 2.8 km / 1.7 mi
Alkhalil Courtyard - 3 km / 1.9 mi
Souk Al-Khalil - 3.1 km / 1.9 mi
King Fahad Gate - 3.1 km / 2 mi
Well of Zamzam - 3.2 km / 2 mi
Maqam Ibrahim - 3.3 km / 2 mi
Kaaba - 3.3 km / 2 mi
Black Stone - 3.3 km / 2 mi
Al Diyafa Mall - 3.3 km / 2.1 mi
The Clock Towers - 3.4 km / 2.1 mi
Al-Salam Gate - 3.4 km / 2.1 mi
Safa and Marwah - 3.5 km / 2.2 mi
Abdul-Qadir Ahmed Nassier Mosque - 3.7 km / 2.3 mi

The nearest major airport is King Abdulaziz Intl. Airport (JED) - 92.2 km / 57.3 mi
Continental breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee.

Make yourself at home in one of the 474 air-conditioned guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and irons/ironing boards.
Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services.
Featured amenities include a business center, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Free self parking is available onsite.

policies.policyDetails:
Fee for continental breakfast: approximately SAR 35 to 75 per person

The above list may not be comprehensive. Fees and deposits may not include tax and are subject to change.

Front desk staff will greet guests on arrival at the property. Information provided by the property may be translated using automated translation tools.

Room occupancy is determined by the property and accommodates the number of guests selected in your search. Bedding arrangements may vary and may not always include a separate bed for each guest. Please ensure the room you book meets your bedding requirements.

Please note that if the bed type (e.g., double bed or twin beds) is not explicitly specified in the room name, bed configuration is subject to hotel availability upon check-in.
Couples wishing to share a room must provide proof of marriage.

Extra-person charges may apply and vary depending on property policy

  • Government-issued photo identification and a credit card, debit card, or cash deposit may be required at check-in for incidental charges
  • Special requests are subject to availability upon check-in and may incur additional charges; special requests cannot be guaranteed
  • This property accepts credit cards and debit cards; cash is not accepted
